title: Implement K-line data service with period aggregation and indicator calculation
description: Create KlineService that: (1) queries daily OHLCV data from stock_daily via StockRepository, (2) aggregates daily data into weekly/monthly K-line bars using pandas resample, (3) computes MACD/KDJ/BOLL indicators by calling existing calc_macd/calc_kdj/calc_boll from indicators.py. This is the core business logic layer.

files.change: KlineService class with get_kline_data() method handling daily/weekly/monthly aggregation + indicator calculation

implementation: Create src/services/kline_service.py with KlineService class accepting DatabaseManager in __init__

Implement _query_daily_data(code, start_date, end_date) -> pd.DataFrame: query StockDaily via SQLAlchemy session, convert to DataFrame with columns [date, open, high, low, close, volume, amount, pct_chg]
Implement _aggregate_weekly(df) -> pd.DataFrame: set date as index, use df.resample('W').agg({open:'first', high:'max', low:'min', close:'last', volume:'sum', amount:'sum'}) to produce weekly bars
Implement _aggregate_monthly(df) -> pd.DataFrame: same as weekly but resample('ME') for month-end aggregation
Implement _compute_indicators(df) -> pd.DataFrame: call calc_macd(df), calc_kdj(df), calc_boll(df) sequentially, return enriched DataFrame with indicator columns

Implement get_kline_data(code, period='daily', start_date=None, end_date=None, limit=500) -> dict: orchestrate query -> aggregate(if needed) -> compute_indicators -> return dict with bars and indicators lists

reference.pattern: Service class with DatabaseManager dependency, pandas DataFrame processing
reference.examples: calc_macd/calc_kdj/calc_boll accept DataFrame with close/high/low columns and append indicator columns. Follow StrategyBacktestService constructor pattern for DatabaseManager injection.

criteria: KlineService.get_kline_data() returns dict with 'bars' and 'indicators' keys
Daily period returns raw daily data without aggregation
Weekly aggregation uses pandas resample('W') with OHLCV aggregation rules (first/max/min/last/sum)
MACD/KDJ/BOLL indicators computed using indicators.py functions
Service handles insufficient data gracefully (return empty lists)

rationale.chosen_approach: Pandas resample for period aggregation because daily data is already in DataFrame form and resample is the idiomatic pandas way
decision_factors: Pandas resample is concise and correct for financial data
rationale.tradeoffs: Requires pandas dependency (already present), slightly more memory than SQL aggregation for very large datasets

manual_checks: Verify weekly bars aggregate Monday-Friday correctly
Verify monthly bars use month-end boundary
Verify indicator columns are present in output
success_metrics: Weekly aggregation produces correct OHLCV for sample data
Monthly aggregation matches expected monthly bars
